title: Closed affine cohomology as an etale-neighborhood colimit
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and $J$ a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with torsion underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf]. For every integer $q\geq0$ there is a small filtered category $I$, schemes $Y_a$ and etale morphisms $v_a:Y_a\to X$, a diagram $H:I\to\mathrm{Ab}$, and a colimit cocone $c$ of $H$. Its point is isomorphic to $H^q(Z,i^{-1}J_{ab})$ and its value at $a$ is isomorphic to $H^q(Y_a,v_a^{-1}J_{ab})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. No injectivity or positive-degree assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Present X and Z as Spec B and Spec B/K. The pair henselization is a filtered colimit of etale neighborhoods with the same closed fibre. Choose a small cofinal directed system of those neighborhoods.
Apply cohomology continuity to the compatible pullbacks of the underlying abelian sheaf. This gives a colimit cocone of neighborhood cohomology with point the henselization cohomology.

Inverse image preserves torsion. Gabber comparison gives the closed-fibre cohomology in every degree. Composition of inverse images and forgetting module coefficients identify it with the restriction along i. Transport the colimit cocone along that isomorphism; do not assert that its point is zero.

theorem Etale.affine_closed_etale_neighborhood_comparison
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (J : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [IsTorsionSheaf J] (q : ℕ) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (Y : I → Scheme.{u}) (v : ∀ a, Y a ⟶ X),
      (∀ a, Etale (v a)) ∧
      ∃ (H : I ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (c : Cocone H),
        Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
        Nonempty (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
            ((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J)) q) ≅ c.pt) ∧
        ∀ a, Nonempty (H.obj a ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
          ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
            ((v a)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj J)) q))
